verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch5.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, G7 and European comparisons)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 3,160 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; unsupported comparisons ('Europe's growth leader', 'small country') and an unsourced note were removed before publishing
